offence: Breach of Article 48.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 3 moved after the 4 second light was illuminated and before the start signal was given, this being a breach of Article 48.1. The Stewards acknowledge that the movement was very slight and no significant sporting advantage was gained and therefore impose the least severe penalty applicable to such infringement.
rules_referenced: Article 48.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
